analysis: P1 static range correction transfer, frozen before raw-bag computation
calibration_method: Per-link whole-P1 median minus surveyed 3D antenna-to-anchor distance; subtract once from other bags. No fitting to validation points.
validation_windows: Oct17 whole static bag; Oct18 use unchanged final stop+[2,7) header-time windows from final review input_manifest.json.
raw_validity: node_0, unique anchor entry in frame, finite positive range. No additional outlier screening.
position_diagnostic: Same unweighted fixed-height least-squares solve on four link medians, three fixed seeds; surveyed validation point never passed to solver.
limits: Historical/calibration-transfer diagnostic, not a blind experiment. P1 offsets and Oct17 transfer were already visible. Unknown survey uncertainties, spatial propagation and mounting changes remain. Range RMS is across link-median residuals, not trajectory RMSE. No model/noise/fusion/IMU parameters changed.
